verdict.rationale: Postman ships a documented REST API for managing collections, workspaces, mocks and analytics (postman-docs-5, postman-docs-27) plus a CLI for running/reporting collections and CI/CD (postman-docs-1, postman-docs-19, postman-probe-6), giving strong programmatic coverage of core API-lifecycle tasks. However, evidence doesn't show parity for all UI capabilities (e.g., live collaboration sessions, role/permission management, governance rule configuration) being fully exposed via API, and there's no independent confirmation of complete UI/API feature parity. Missing for 10: explicit mapping of every UI feature (live sessions, RBAC, governance UI) to API endpoints, and independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs.
